comparison.objective: Place a nickel strip on four cells and touch each location with a spot-welding tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-strip placement, sequential two-tip tool contact, tool pickup, and return.
comparison.success_condition: Strip alignment, four timed probe contacts, returned welder, clear arms, and 1 s rest; damage/drop failures apply.
comparison.reason: This is surface placement and repeated welding contact, not constrained blade insertion that releases an internally latched terminal.
